description: This file contains a test class 'BasketPageCheckout' implementing functional tests for the basket checkout page in an ASP.NET Core web application. It verifies behaviors like redirection to login when the user is not authenticated, adding items to the cart, and checking the contents of responses.

classes.name: BasketPageCheckout
classes.description: A test class using Xunit in a sequential collection to test basket checkout functionality, especially redirect behavior when not authenticated.

methods.name: BasketPageCheckout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpClient used for testing by creating a test server with specified options.

methods.name: RedirectsToLoginIfNotAuthenticated
methods.description: Test method that simulates adding an item to the basket as an anonymous user and verifies redirection to login page during checkout.
